integrity: The proof uses the published exhaustive facet classification, exact centering of the facet normals, polarity, and explicit lower-bound labelings. The graph-spread identity is derived from the zero-mean Euclidean norm of Lipschitz functions. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts and the canonical Euclidean root realization. It does not compute other metric invariants or non-Euclidean radii. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent complete-multipartite spread formula under different graph-concentration terminology.
title: Largest part versus balanced cut: the exact inradius phase diagram for complete multipartite symmetric edge polytopes
